messages:
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 has been marked RESOLVED by oncall. Root cause: autoscaler race during a regional redeploy. Please schedule a post-incident review within the next 7 days and assign a facilitator. Link: https://rwinf.incidents/INC-2026-0421 :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: I can take facilitator if no one else is up for it. I'm tied up Wed morning but free Thu/Fri afternoon PST. Will need a co-fac for note-taking (can be junior eng). :raising_hand:
Ashok Patel: thanks Maria — appreciate it. FYI legal asked for a short customer-impact summary to be in the notes. We should invite CS lead and a product PM. I'm blocked Fri after 4pm PST though.
Samir Khanna: +1 to Maria facilitating. For attendees we need: oncall, runtime, infra, product, CS, and maybe Benchmarks/Optimize if regression suspected. Can someone paste the short timeline?
Eng Oncall: handoff log: oncall @samir took paged alert 1834909871, escalated to @maria 1834910200, mitigation applied at 1834950000, service returned to normal at 1834990000. See /var/logs/incidents/INC-2026-0421-summary.txt
Leah Ortiz: I can co-facilitate note-taking but I'm traveling Mon-Tue in CET. Thu/Fri afternoon PST should work for me too. If Maria's facilitating, I can prep action-item tracker in the postmortem doc.
Maria Chen: Great — Leah can co-fac. Samir can you confirm the customer list? We need to mark who had bounded SLA impact vs degraded experience.
Samir Khanna: Quick summary (paste): ```
- 11:02 UTC: autoscaler failed to attach instance group
- 11:07 UTC: traffic spikes -> elevated latencies for embeddings endpoint
- 11:22 UTC: fallback to lower-capacity pool triggered (partial mitigation)
- 11:35 UTC: manual redeploy and fixed node config -> latencies returned to normal
- Impact: ~8% of requests saw >2x latency for ~30m; two customers reported timeouts, no data loss
```
Ashok Patel: Sounds right. For scheduling: can we aim for Thu 16:00 PST (Fri 00:00 UTC)? That hits APAC late though. If we want APAC folks, Fri 01:00 UTC is rough. Maybe record and ask specific async reviewers.
Maria Chen: Preference is Thu 16:00 PST. Leah, Samir, Ashok, Eng Oncall + CS lead (Lauren) invited. I'll create calendar invite and link notes. Can someone add Lauren and product PM (@nina)?
Incident Bot: Reminder: runbook checklist state: triage-complete=true, RCA-started=false. Suggested follow-up: run RCA steps 1-4 and link any config diffs. Auto-create postmortem doc when calendar event created.
Leah Ortiz: I'll draft the first pass of the RCA template today and drop it in the doc. Maria — can you add the customer-impact blurb? I can add logs and perf graphs.
Samir Khanna: I'll attach a short perf diff and the autoscaler config snippets to the doc before the meeting. ```yaml
autoscaler:
  version: 2.1.3
  attach_timeout: 60s
  retry_policy: exponential
```
Ashok Patel: One more thing — let's flag the action item to add a canary step in deploys for the autoscaler component. Assign to infra-team and set due 2 weeks from meeting.
Maria Chen: noted. I'll create action items and assign owners during the meeting. If anyone can't make Thu 16:00 PST, say now and we'll record.
Eng Oncall: I might have a conflict at 16:00-16:30 PST, but can join from 16:30. If that blocks, move to 17:00?
Maria Chen: Let's keep 16:00 PST and I'll start recorder at the top; Leah, if possible please take over the first 30m facil notes until Eng Oncall joins. If not, we'll shift to 16:30.
Leah Ortiz: I can cover first 30m. I'll post the invite in #calendar and ping Lauren + Nina. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: Postmortem doc created: https://rwinf.incidents/docs/INC-2026-0421-postmortem (access: eng + cs + product). Meeting scheduled tentative Thu 16:00 PST. Record flag: true.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. I'll finalize the invite and add the agenda: timeline, root cause hypotheses, mitigations taken, action items, follow-ups. See you Thu. :slightly_smiling_face:
